name: Mother Puckers | 200mg Live Rosin Gummies | Puck'd & Pumped
description:
Get Lit. Stay Sharp.

Puck’d & Pumped is not your average edible—it’s your new daytime ride-or-die. This Supercharged Super Sour Chew was built for clarity, creativity, and caffeine-free energy. Each gummy is its own burst of bold berry attitude: Blueberry, Wildberry, Sour Raspberry, and Cloudberry—drenched in our signature sour sugar and finished with a juicy, mouthwatering sweetness.

Infused with a powerful blend of 200mg THC Live Rosin + 100mg CBD + 100mg CBG, this Sativa-dominant formula is crafted to help you feel clear-headed, dialed in, and ready to run the world. Whether you're at the gym, on the clock, or chasing a creative spark, this chew hits different.

Loud flavors. Loud effects. Loud brand. Vegan, gluten-free, heat-resistant. #PAFO
